spec.name: IO circuit v2: duplicate heads -> S2 readers -> name movers (+ supporting heads, mlp0-6)
spec.code:
def predict(tokens, prompt):
    import re
    # Candidate names = capitalised words after the opening 'When'.
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+", prompt)
    names = [w for w in words[1:] if w[0].isupper()]
    first_two = names[:2]
    later = names[2:]
    # Step 1 (E0009, E0012, E0024): at S2, heads 3.0 (S2->S1) and 5.5 (S2->S1+1), with 6.9, mark the S2 name as already seen.
    repeated = [n for n in first_two if n in later]
    # Step 2 (E0005, E0008, E0011, E0023): 7.3, 7.9, 8.6, 8.10 at END read S2 and set the name movers' queries.
    # Step 3 (E0008, E0010, E0020): 9.9 / 9.6 / 10.0 attend to the name that is NOT repeated and copy it to the logits;
    # 10.7 / 11.10 attend to the same name and partially cancel it (E0010, E0014), which does not change the argmax.
    candidates = [n for n in first_two if n not in repeated]
    if candidates:
        return ' ' + candidates[0]
    return ' ' + first_two[0]
